headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveLegacyWord_law
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j) (h : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveLegacyWordLaw xs ys htotal h =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.restoreZeroMarginListsLaw xs ys
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
        (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveLegacyReducedWord xs ys htotal h))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveLegacyWord_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j) (h : ℕ),
  ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveLegacyWordLaw xs ys htotal h)
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw) ≤
    ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveDeterministicWord_law
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.deterministic →
    OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
        (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveDeterministicWord xs ys htotal) =
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
